name: routine.health
description: Judge a routine's RUN OUTPUT -- not its definition: did this run produce its artifact, is the output non-vacuous, did it hit a BLOCKED line, and did it stay inside the wire. This is the run-level health check that routine.run cannot give, because routine.run judges the definition and escalates every output.

artifact.instructions: The run output names at least one concrete artifact it produced: a file path, an exported row count, a URL, a receipt, a decision id, or a named record it wrote.

non_vacuous.instructions: The output contains real content -- counts, names, rows, findings, diffs, or values -- and not only a status word such as done, success, completed, or 'nothing to do'.

blocked_line.instructions: The output contains an explicit BLOCKED: or ERROR line, or states plainly that the run failed or could not do the work it was scheduled to do. A run that says there was nothing to do is NOT a blocked run -- that is a vacuous run and the other questions carry it.

outward_action.instructions: The run performed or queued an outward action: sending mail or a message, publishing or posting, pushing to git, deploying, spending money, or changing a credential.

quality.instructions: How trustworthy this run output is as evidence the routine did its job
criteria: A status word with nothing behind it
A claim of success with no artifact and no content
Names the command or the mode but not the result
Names a produced artifact and real content, with no BLOCKED line
Artifact, real content, counts the run can back up, and a stated next run

rules.reason: the run reported BLOCKED or ERROR -- it did not do its job and must not be called done
outward action inside a routine run -- Gate-D before anything leaves the wire
no artifact named -- vacuous run, and a clean run with zero output is indistinguishable from success
output is non-substantive -- there is nothing here to verify
this output is not evidence of a completed run

notes.scope: Input is the OUTPUT TEXT of one run. routine.run (the existing pack) judges the routine's definition and escalates every output by design; this pack is the missing run-level gate.
notes.thresholds: Provisional and uncalibrated (law 3), so the two BLOCK rules currently report ESCALATE with a downgraded-BLOCK reason. The house bar applies to artifact and non_vacuous: a required noul passes only above 0.90.
notes.blocked_line_reworded: Reworded after decision 120508: the vacuous fixture ('Completed successfully. Nothing to do this week.') scored blocked_line 0.58 with the old wording ('was skipped' caught 'nothing to do'), firing a reason that named the wrong failure. Verdict was already correct via artifact/non_vacuous/quality.
